autoChain.title: Auto Chain
autoChain.description: Choose your exit and relay subscriptions. Each complete route is tested to select an available relay.
autoChain.target: 3. Which proxy group should use this route?
autoChain.hint: The active route and up to two backups are probed every 2 seconds, with a 2-second timeout. All routes are scanned at the interval above, even during outages. Tests include connection handshakes and consume traffic. Existing connections may need to reconnect. Settings apply to this profile.
autoChain.recovering: No healthy route yet. Probing continues automatically.
autoChain.notSelected: Monitoring is enabled, but the target group is using another route. Apply to select this chain.
autoChain.unavailable: Cannot read live core status. Last results may be outdated.
autoChain.loadFailed: Unable to load subscription nodes. Reopen to retry.
autoChain.directMode: Switch to Rule or Global mode before connecting the automatic chain.
autoChain.route: This device → Automatic relay → Your exit → Website
autoChain.routeHint: Relays are tested and switched automatically. The final hop stays on your chosen exit node.
autoChain.exitHelp: For example, choose your Japan residential node to use its public IP, rather than choosing the Hong Kong relay here.
autoChain.targetHelp: Use an existing proxy group. Only traffic routed to “{{group}}” uses this chain. This does not force all traffic through a proxy. Choose GLOBAL in global mode to handle all proxy traffic.
autoChain.toleranceHelp: Avoid switching on small latency changes. This threshold does not apply when the current route fails.
autoChain.summary: Keeps checking and finds another relay after a failure. Existing connections may need to reconnect. Settings apply to the current subscription.
autoChain.sourcesHelp: Select subscriptions to test. All candidate routes are tested concurrently on startup, then continuously. Duplicate nodes and the exit endpoint are excluded.
autoChain.progress: Results since this configuration loaded: {{completed}} / {{total}} routes
autoChain.resultsHint: Latency includes connection and request time from this device through the relay and fixed exit to the HTTPS test site. Reachable refers to that complete route only. A failure can occur at either hop or at the 2-second test timeout. Full scans run up to 10 tests concurrently; active and backup probes run separately.
autoChain.noResults: No matching nodes. Check selected subscriptions and available nodes.
autoChain.initialScan: Running the initial full-route scan. Results appear as each test completes…

claudeGuard.title: Claude exit protection
claudeGuard.description: Chrome and Edge requests to the listed Claude domains always use your existing fixed-exit gateway. Other websites keep their current rules.
claudeGuard.route: Chrome / Edge → Clash → protection gateway → 103.5.250.92 → Claude
claudeGuard.blocked: Gateway unavailable or exit not verified. Protected requests may be blocked.
claudeGuard.boundary: Requires the local Claude protection gateway on port 17891. Browser firewall rules must also be installed separately to prevent bypassing Clash. Domain routing does not cover unknown third-party domains.
claudeGuard.mode: Protection locks rule mode across subscriptions. Enabling it closes existing proxy connections so they reconnect through the new rules.
